title: Unknown Cause
paragraphs: It was about a week after we reported this matter to the Pig King of Faubrey, and just one day before the wave in Melromarc was about to arrive. It happened while I was with Father and the others, searching for Filo-tan’s egg. By the way, it had been decided that the Queen would handle the wave in Melromarc. She had expressed her desire to gain experience in suppressing the wave together with the castle soldiers.
At that moment, a blue hourglass display suddenly appeared in my vision.
“…Huh?”

Father looked back and forth between me, Ren, and Itsuki. I, Ren, and Itsuki exchanged stunned glances. This is strange. Even though Ren and Itsuki are right here in front of us, the seal has been broken.
“Wh-What’s going on?”
“We haven’t done anything.”
“There should have been more time left.”
“Don’t tell me… A reincarnator like Ren or Itsuki used game knowledge to unseal the Spirit Tortoise?”
“…That’s not impossible.”
“Or maybe, the timing was different compared to the game.”
Could it really be that the seal would break even without Ren and Itsuki intervening? Father and the others are deducing that a reincarnator might be responsible for this.
“Judging by the numbers and Motoyasu-kun’s explanation, it’s definitely the Spirit Tortoise…”
“We were in the process of negotiating with the king and queen since we originally planned to go there as part of diplomatic efforts.”
That’s right. We thought we could prevent the Spirit Tortoise’s revival by keeping Ren and Itsuki in check, but some reincarnator went and triggered it? They need to stop messing around.
“The schedule was supposed to allow enough time to at least evacuate people and minimize the damage…”
“Wait a minute. Does this mean the Spirit Tortoise revived without any evacuations?”
“Anyway! What we need to do is take down the Spirit Tortoise. That’s the priority.”
“Yeah. But… considering the location… Do we still have the portals?”
“We have the one for the Phoenix. And there’s the portal we registered during the last loop while heading toward the Spirit Tortoise… It’s still intact.”
It’s from when we were tracking Ren and Itsuki who seemed to be heading toward the Spirit Tortoise. We almost erased it, but it’s going to come in handy now.
“That’s great!”
“But even with that, it’ll still take about two days to reach the Spirit Tortoise.”
This world is quite vast after all. If the Filolials ran without rest, we might be able to make it in a day, but considering Father and the others’ condition, that would be difficult.
“Which would be faster… using Faubrey’s airplane or the portal?”
“The problem is the location of the airstrip. If we’re departing from Faubrey, I think the portal would be faster.”
“You’re right. Plus, if the airplane gets shot down by the Spirit Tortoise’s attacks, we’d be in serious trouble.”
“Oh my? What’s going on?”

As we were having this conversation, the elder sister of the older sister and the panda approached us. By the way, it seems that the elder sister of the older sister and the panda had been leveling up after their class upgrade. It looks like their subordinates have also been steadily leveling up. Apparently, the elder sister of the older sister has shown impressive growth, which surprised Father. However, he also mentioned that she couldn’t fine-tune her abilities like Éclair. I wonder what the reason is?
“Iwatani-dono, from the looks of it… did something happen that only the Heroes would understand?”
Even Éclair seemed to grasp the situation after listening to Father and the others.
“Ah, Eclair-san, Sadeena-san. Actually—”
Father explained to everyone that the Spirit Tortoise had revived.
“Do we really have to fight such a monster?”
The panda looked like it was considering escape. Escape is not an option, you hear?
“Hmm… Sadeena-san and Larsa-san’s levels, abilities, and potential are still a bit uncertain… It might be safer for them to retreat.”
“Yes, staying around recklessly could be dangerous.”

By the way, Stalker Pig was sitting rather energetically beside Itsuki. It was able to walk about three days after it regained the ability to respond and has been following Itsuki around since, showing admiration. To me, all I can hear is “Buu Buu,” though.
“Bubweee…”
“It’s okay, Rishia-san. Please stay somewhere safe too.”
“B-Bubu…”
“I understand how you feel, but Rishia-san, you’ve only just recovered and are still in the process of becoming stronger. Please, be patient for now.”
When Itsuki spoke to her gently, Stalker Pig seemed to nod with a dreamy expression. They’re creating an atmosphere here. I want to create such a sweet atmosphere with Filo-tan as well.
“Naofumi’s group is lively as always, but Itsuki seems to be surrounded by a rather pink atmosphere lately.”
“Ren-san! Don’t tease me! And besides, what about you?”
At Itsuki’s pointed remark, Ren looked at Éclair and Assistant. Well, that’s a safe choice.
“What is it, Amaki-dono?”
“Hm? What?”
After letting out a light sigh, Ren turned his gaze back to Itsuki.
“These two are not an option.”
“What do you mean, Amaki-dono!”
“I already have Father!”
Éclair and Assistant looked furious. Itsuki also seemed slightly exasperated. It looks like, unlike in the first world, Ren does not have any romantic feelings for Éclair or Assistant.
“If we’re going to face the Spirit Tortoise, I can’t bring Imiya-chan’s relatives… They’re still in the process of getting stronger, and we don’t have enough people who can fight yet.”
“Um… I can come along, right?”
“If Imiya-chan wants to come… I guess it’s okay?”
“It’s fine! Gaelion will protect Imiya-chan properly.”
“Thank you, Gaelion-chan. For now, as for the team selection… Sakura-chan, Kou, and the Filolials, can I ask you all to provide support from the rear?”
“Got it!”
“Kou too!”
By the way, Yuki-chan is currently in the final stages of preparation for the Filolial race in Zeltoble’s Filolial racehouse.
“Yuki-chan isn’t here… Should I call her back?”
“The race is coming up!”
“Is it really okay to weigh the world and the race on the same scale?” Itsuki asked me.
Hmm… that’s true… It’s rare for Itsuki to say something reasonable. Father responded to his words.
“Probably, if we tell Yuki-chan, she’d come back without a second thought… but after all the preparation she’s put in, asking her now…”

Hearing Father’s words, Itsuki fell silent, looking apologetic. That’s right. Yuki-chan has been looking forward to the race. Considering Yuki-chan’s feelings, it would be unthinkable to let a mere Spirit Tortoise ruin her dream.

“If we call her back, she might not be able to compete in the race. But if we don’t call her back, Yuki-chan will be angry. Either way, we’re going to hurt Yuki-chan. I think Motoyasu should decide where his compassion lies. Motoyasu… what do you want to do?”

Father turned to me and asked for a decision. I reflected on everything that had happened over the past two weeks. Yuki-chan’s passion for the Filolial race… My own learning and preparations for the race…

The countless efforts we’ve put in. Yuki-chan has been restricting her diet and limiting her exercise to prepare for the race. She’s been taking great care of her legs. The race is just around the corner. If I pull Yuki-chan out of the racehouse now, she’ll be disqualified.
Can I really tell her to give up the race just because the Spirit Tortoise has revived? Even the Filolial breeders went out of their way to accommodate us.
“When it comes to human lives, our top priority should be to defeat the Spirit Tortoise as soon as possible. I think we should call Yuki-san back immediately.”
“Wait, Itsuki… There are plenty of Filolials. We can fill the gap left by Yuki. For Yuki’s dream, we should take down the Spirit Tortoise ourselves.”
Ren and Itsuki were at odds with their arguments. Human lives are indeed important. But Yuki-chan has a dream.
I’m sure Yuki-chan would give up the race if I asked her to. But I can’t let all of Yuki-chan’s hard work go to waste. Even if I have to harden my heart, I can’t let Yuki-chan’s efforts be in vain.
“Yuki-chan… should participate in the race. Father, is there any way we can move against the Spirit Tortoise faster for Yuki-chan’s sake?”
“I see… Okay. If that’s what Motoyasu has decided, I won’t say anything more.”
“Even if Yuki-chan gets angry with me, I won’t tell her.”
